styleBlock: Draw this in exactly the same drawing style as the reference images, on a plain white background.

segments.title: John Jairo Velasquez "Popeye"

shots.intent: Nguoi nay la sat thu so mot cua cartel — nghe nghiep, khong phai danh tinh
shots.draw: A man in his late twenties standing, seen from the chest up, wearing a scuffed black leather jacket over a plain shirt, holding a pistol down at his side in one hand. Short dark hair, clean shaven, stocky build, calm blank expression.
A 1980s Colombian police peaked cap lying on its side, dark navy crown, black patent brim, a blank round metal badge above the brim with no lettering and no emblem.
A wooden judge's gavel resting on its round striking block, dark polished hardwood with a brass band around the head.
A 1980s press photographer's camera: a black 35mm SLR body with a wide lens and a bulky rectangular flash unit mounted on top, a worn fabric neck strap hanging loose.

shots.intent: Nan nhan gom CHINH TRI GIA — buc noi bo TRONG, khong ve mot chinh tri gia co that
shots.draw: An empty wooden campaign podium seen from the front, with two slim microphones angled up from its top edge and a blank front panel bearing no lettering, no seal and no flag. Nobody standing at it.

shots.intent: Cach gay an: bom gai trong xe
shots.draw: The open trunk of a 1980s sedan seen from behind, lid raised. Inside the trunk sits a taped bundle of cylindrical sticks with coloured wires running from it to a small box. The rest of the car is cropped away below the trunk opening.

shots.intent: 110 nguoi chet tren mot chuyen bay hanh khach
shots.draw: A 1980s twin-engine passenger jet airliner in level flight seen from the side, white fuselage with a plain unmarked tail fin, no lettering, no livery stripes, no logo, on a plain background with no sky and no clouds.

shots.intent: Muc tieu that KHONG co tren may bay — day la cai lam vu do that bai
shots.draw: A single empty aircraft passenger seat seen from the front, grey-blue upholstery, seat belt unbuckled and lying loosely across the cushion, tray table folded up.

shots.intent: Chi la CAO BUOC co ta lien lac voi doi thu — hinh trung tinh, khong ve co ta, khong ve cuoc gap
shots.draw: A 1980s desk telephone with the handset lifted off its cradle and lying on its side beside the base, the coiled cord stretched and twisted.

shots.intent: Ra dau thu: bi dan di giua hai nguoi vu trang
shots.draw: Three men walking forward side by side, seen full length from head to shoes. The man in the middle wears a plain shirt and dark trousers with his wrists handcuffed in front of him, head lowered. The two men flanking him wear plain olive-green military fatigues and soft caps, each with a rifle slung across the chest, one hand on the middle man's upper arm.

shots.intent: 23 nam trong tu — do dai thoi gian de hau ky gan chu, hinh chi can noi 'nha tu'
shots.draw: A bare prison cell seen from inside: a narrow steel bunk with a thin mattress against one wall, a small square window high up crossed by four vertical bars, bare concrete floor and walls, nothing else in the cell.

shots.cue: reinvented himself as a YouTube personality
shots.intent: Sau khi ra tu thi lam kenh video ke lai chuyen cu
shots.draw: A smartphone clamped upright in a small desktop tripod, screen facing the viewer and blank, with a round ring light on a second stand beside it. No lettering and no icons on the screen.

shots.intent: Bi bat lai — de rieng khoi canh dau thu o A2-10 de hau ky dung duoc hai moc khac nhau
shots.draw: A pair of steel handcuffs lying open, one cuff swung back on its hinge, the short chain between them slack.

shots.outName: Empty Hospital Bed With Barred Window
shots.intent: Chet vi benh TRONG LUC DANG BI GIAM — thanh cua so gan la thu noi len 'trong trai giam'
shots.draw: An empty hospital bed seen from the side, white sheets rumpled and pushed back, a rolling drip stand standing beside it with an empty bag, and behind the bed a window crossed by four vertical bars. Nobody in the bed.

segments._noteEnd: SHOT-LIST v1 ghi A2 = 1:19-2:08, nhung cau ke ve cai chet cua Popeye chay tiep toi ~2:12 moi sang Kuklinski. Da noi `end` ra 2:12 theo dung loi ke, khong theo moc cu — cue 'he died of stomach cancer' o 2:11 la cua A2.
